title: tier-2 shipped code: the type-0 sphere narrowphase against 0x142ccdf40

unreachableBranches.why: The support-point path (count > 0) hands the block to 0x142cc9460, which is unread. Every fixture case passes count = 0, so the fall-through edge is never taken.

notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/collide.rs (sphere_sweep), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the collision_sphere entry.

The oracle runs the real 0x142ccdf40 and the harness compares the whole 0x44-byte output pointee (three quads plus the trailing ids) byte for byte. A miss leaves the output untouched on both sides, so the hit/miss branch is part of the compared channel.
The unit declares the function's exact extent (0x4ec) because the image's .pdata entry stops at 0x42 bytes.

The record is {centre, radius}, the transform {position, world->local quaternion}, and the block start/end/motion/expansion with the +0x72 flag; the quaternion edge pool includes a zero, a non-unit and the IEEE specials.
acknowledgedGaps: Only the count <= 0 path is verified. The count > 0 path (the shared support-point routine 0x142cc9460) is open, and so are the other four shape types, the hit policy and the geometry ingest.
